title: enhance-probing-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Sofia Martinez
description: This PR implements enhanced probing and stability guards for unified rollouts autorollback workflows across canary, A/B and shadow deployments. Motivation: several incidents showed that small probe sample sizes and mismatch between shadow and live probe sampling caused spurious metric-driven rollbacks; operators saw noisy alerts and unnecessary rollbacks during low traffic windows. The changes introduce an adaptive probing scheduler that increases probe sample size when metric variance is high, sample-weighted metric aggregation for shadow traffic to better match production distributions, a configurable minimum probe window and a statistical-significance check before triggering rollbacks. A new optional 'probing' block has been added to the rollout policy DSL to enable staged probing (ramp probe traffic), extended windows, and per-metric significance thresholds. The rollout controller integrates the scheduler and performs a pre-rollback evaluation that requires both threshold breaches and a significance pass. Observability: added probe-specific metrics (rollout.probe.samples, rollout.probe.variance, rollout.pre_rollback_significance) and Grafana panels for probe health and decision reasoning. Tests: unit tests for scheduler and aggregator, integration tests for controller logic, and an e2e suite that runs a staged shadow-canary scenario. Backwards compatibility: default rollout behavior is unchanged unless an operator opts into the new probing block. Migration: rollout CRD bumped to v2alpha3 with a lightweight migration helper that copies existing policies. Related tickets: ENG-3180 (probe stability work) and ENG-3129 (shadow traffic parity). CI summary: initial e2e flake on the first run (timing-dependent), rerun succeeded and all checks passed. Merge method: squash. See commits and changed files for details.

release_notes: - Add adaptive probing scheduler for rollout autorollback workflows. - Add sample-weighted metric aggregation for shadow traffic to reduce false positives. - Add pre-rollback statistical significance checks and configurable probing block in rollout DSL. - CRD v2alpha3 migration helper for rollout policies. - New probe observability metrics and Grafana panels.
notes: Operators must opt into the new 'probing' block to enable staged probing and extended windows. Default behavior unchanged. Rolling upgrade for controllers can be performed with zero-downtime by following the migration helper in migration.go.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured probing thresholds can delay real rollbacks. Mitigation: defaults use conservative alpha and minWindow, and controller emits pre-rollback diagnostic events; recommend canary on low-traffic services first.
